scope: Independent appearance-only review of original full-resolution input files, each supplied individually to vision_analyze. Paths are relative to launch/qa-art-06. No contact sheets or substituted thumbnails used.
limitations: Static screenshots cannot certify animation, pivot placement, collision clearance, closure alignment, touch/keyboard interaction, hidden geometry, structural integrity or custody behavior.
Marketing references show only closed exterior views; open interiors have no matching reference and cannot be called reference-faithful.
Minor edge jaggedness and soft details are visible, but screenshots do not distinguish model, rendering and image-scaling causes.
No unmistakable major missing surface or viewport clipping was identified in these views; this is not proof of defect-free models.
Small mobile header/help/disclaimer text is a readability limitation, not a measured accessibility verdict.

inspected.observation: Fully framed slate-gray chest with gold clasp, separate round fitting, side ring and lid caps. Bright cyan lake inset carries two fluted green-and-gray volcanoes; mottled body is visually busier than flat terrain.

Raised plain mottled gray lid, empty gray cavity and turquoise rim visible. Full lid tab and feet fit. Rear separation and stepped corner/rim joints are conspicuous but not demonstrated holes or penetration.
Whole twin-volcano silhouette and hardware remain legible with no horizontal clipping. One-line title fits. Gray feet and small fittings look angular; stone texture is somewhat smeared at this scale.
Full raised lid, tab, body and feet fit above unobstructed controls. Empty cavity is readable but interior floor boundaries are muted. Segmented turquoise/gray rim corners remain visible.
Slate-blue stone-like chest, turquoise inset and seam, joined pale sage/mint island with two fluted gray-topped volcanoes, brass caps/clasp/round disk/side ring, low rounded gray feet.

items.reference_comparison: Core motif, palette families, slab silhouette and hardware arrangement are retained. Screenshot terrain reads more saturated green and stone mottling more pronounced than the reference; lighting may contribute. Reference feet look rounder and finish softer.
visible_finish_limitations: Stepped rim/corner transitions and small jagged edges.
Rougher-looking feet and a stronger textured-body versus flat-terrain contrast than the reference.
artistic_gaps_not_defects: Flat cyan water and faceted fluted volcanoes are already part of the reference language.
Lack of vegetation or realistic waves is not missing required geometry.
items.follow_up: User should judge the greener terrain and coarser stone/feet finish. Inspect rim joints and hinge area in motion separately before any mechanical claim.

inspected.observation: Ivory floral-repeat body, cobalt lid with three raised pale aqua/ivory flowers, gold caps/clasp/round fitting/side ring and gray feet. Fully framed; body repeat is softer than lid/hardware and feet look rough.
Plain cobalt inner lid and empty cobalt cavity are visible, with patterned exterior retained. Raised tab and feet fully fit. Rear lid separation and rim joints do not establish broken geometry.
Three flowers and cobalt/ivory palette remain identifiable. Whole box and side-by-side controls fit; angular hardware/feet and softened floral pattern are the main visible finish limitations.
Blue underside and cavity read clearly as open and empty. Entire lid/tab and body fit; small edge jaggedness but no obvious missing panel or text overlap.

Cobalt lid with three raised eight-petal daisies alternating aqua and ivory around gold centers; ivory body with diagonal blue floral repeat and fine aqua strokes. Brass caps, central clasp, round disk, side ring and low irregular gray feet.

items.reference_comparison: Distinct three-flower composition, blue floral body, cobalt lid, gold hardware and gray feet are retained. Exact petal count and fine repeat fidelity cannot be certified at screenshot display scale. Rough stone-like feet are present in the source, so they are not an invented material mismatch.
visible_finish_limitations: Soft/mechanically tiled-looking floral repeat and faceted small fittings.
Gray feet visually contrast with smooth decorative panels.
artistic_gaps_not_defects: Repeating floral decoration, simple glossy lid and unusual gray feet are reference features.
Open cobalt interior is an unreferenced design choice, not evidence of fidelity failure.
items.follow_up: User should judge craft/glaze richness and pattern sharpness rather than treating the existing gray feet as a defect. Verify moving hardware separately.

inspected.observation: Cream patterned chest with cobalt frame and feet, raised blue flower with gold center and brass fittings. Whole object fits. Some border transitions and small motif edges are uneven/soft.

Raised cobalt inner lid contrasts with plain pale empty cavity. Complete lid tab and feet fit. No obvious major missing wall; rear gaps and rim segmentation remain visually ambiguous construction details.

Cobalt/cream motif and flower remain clear. Title wraps cleanly to two lines; full model and controls fit. Pale panels read chalkier than a strong ceramic glaze, and hardware is angular at this scale.
Open pale cavity and cobalt lid remain legible and fully framed. Interior is plain with limited tonal depth; small repeat details are soft, but no obvious missing wall or major hole is visible.

Squat ivory/cobalt chest with blue-ring green-dot medallions, central eight-petal blue flower and gold center, short cobalt block feet, gold corner caps, clasp, separate round fitting and left ring pull.

items.reference_comparison: Blue frame/feet, cream medallion panels, single blue flower and gold hardware preserve the identifying composition. Fine green-dot medallion interiors and exact petal shape are less inspectable in the screenshots. Source reads smooth/satin; the mobile body is somewhat chalkier.
visible_finish_limitations: Soft motif details and slight roughness along patterned borders and small metal fittings.
Plain pale interior has limited tonal separation.
artistic_gaps_not_defects: Blue feet and regular medallion repeat match the reference rather than indicating simplification errors.
Dark closed seam and exposed open rear clearance are not by themselves holes.
items.follow_up: User should judge ceramic/satin material character and fine motif fidelity. No screenshot-based motion or closure approval.

inspected.observation: Pale mottled stone body, turquoise lid, low green island and two pointed faceted green mountains with pale markings. Brass hardware and gray rounded feet present; whole model fits.

Plain turquoise inner lid, muted green rim and empty gray-green cavity. Exterior mountain motif is not visible from this open angle. Raised tab and feet fit; dark rear separation and corner seams are noticeable.
Pitons, water-colored lid and gold clasp remain identifiable; title wraps naturally and no mountain/foot clipping occurs. Fine fittings and cloudy stone texture are soft at mobile scale.
Turquoise underside and gray-green empty interior are fully framed above controls. Some corner trim looks offset/segmented; static view cannot resolve intended joins versus alignment issues.

Pale blue-gray stone-like chest, thick turquoise lid and muted green seam, two unequal faceted green mountain spires with pale triangular markings on a low island, brass fittings and rounded gray bun feet.

items.reference_comparison: Reference silhouette, unequal twin green peaks, triangular mountain highlights, turquoise lid, pale body and hardware layout are retained. Body has a cloudier/coarser stone read in screenshots. Open view hides the exterior landscape rather than proving it missing.
visible_finish_limitations: Cloudy body texture and softened small hardware.
Angular/offset-looking corner and rim joins deserve another angle, not an automatic defect label.
artistic_gaps_not_defects: Faceted mountains and sparse pale triangular marks already occur in the reference.
No photoreal forest, waves or detailed foliage is required by the stylized source.
items.follow_up: User should judge stone finish and landscape refinement. Inspect corner joins and lid clearance interactively before any mechanical conclusion.

inspected.observation: Pale warm speckled chest with turquoise irregular lagoon, cream shoreline and three rounded boulders. Turquoise seam, gold hardware and low irregular feet visible; entire model fits.

Raised pale speckled slab underside and empty stone-colored cavity with segmented turquoise rim. Complete tab and feet fit; floor partly obscured by front wall. No unmistakable major crack or missing panel.
Three-rock grouping, lagoon and warm brass remain readable; two-line heading and controls fit. Stone reads chalky/concrete-like, with subtle rather than strongly crystalline speckling.
Whole raised lid and body fit. Interior appears empty but floor/depth are less distinct; turquoise-to-pale rim transitions look slightly uneven. No obvious major breakage or clipping.
Matte pale finely speckled chest with turquoise seam and asymmetrical pool inside ivory shoreline, three upright rounded rocks, low pebble feet and gold caps/clasp/round disk/side ring.

items.reference_comparison: Three-rock lagoon composition, pale speckled palette, turquoise seam, low pebble feet and hardware remain faithful at the visible composition level. Source also has subdued grain; a concrete/limestone read is an artistic material-specificity limitation, not proof that the model lost granite texture.
visible_finish_limitations: Small stepped rim/corner transitions and softened hardware edges.
Open interior floor is not easy to distinguish at mobile scale.
artistic_gaps_not_defects: Flat lagoon, rounded rock forms and irregular feet are source features.
Increasing crystalline granite detail would be artistic refinement, not repair of a demonstrated missing material.
items.follow_up: User should judge whether the subtle stone grain communicates the intended granite theme. Inspect rim joints and motion separately.
